verdict.rationale: Airwallex's first-party docs describe webhooks that push real-time notifications to your application when account events occur [airwallex-docs-9]. Delivery is an HTTP POST with a JSON payload to your URL [airwallex-docs-26]. This clearly covers the core of subscribing to events via webhooks. Missing for 10: details on event-type selection and subscription management, signature verification and retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
